notes: Answers use settings placeholders filled in onboarding. ai_can_answer false means the AI acknowledges and routes to staff.

question_variants: what if there's an emergency after hours
who do I call at night
entries.answer: If it's an emergency while we're closed, please go to {{er_name}} at {{er_address}}, {{er_phone}}. I can text you those details.

question_variants: can I bring my new dog
entries.default_setting_value: Yes, we're welcoming new clients. I can get you set up right now.

question_variants: do I need to bring anything
entries.notes: Derived from the booked service's what_to_bring list.

entries.answer: Yes. If you give me the name of the clinic, the team will request the records before your visit.

entries.default_setting_value: Most pet insurance works by reimbursement. You pay at the visit and we give you everything you need to file the claim. {{direct_billing_note}}

question_variants: how much does a spay cost
entries.notes: Range only. For surgery add: the doctor confirms the estimate after the exam.

entries.answer: I'll pass the refill request to the team. They usually have it ready in {{refill_turnaround}} and will text you when it is.
The team handles pharmacy approvals, usually within {{refill_turnaround}}. I'll let them know it's waiting.

question_variants: what time do I drop off for surgery
when can I pick up after surgery
entries.answer: Drop-off is {{surgery_drop_off_window}} and pickup is usually {{surgery_pickup_window}}. The team will call you when {{pet_name}} is awake and ready.

question_variants: does my dog need to fast
entries.answer: No food after midnight the night before. Water is fine. If {{pet_name}} is on medication, the team will tell you whether to give the morning dose.

question_variants: is there a deposit for surgery
what shots does my puppy need
entries.answer: The doctor sets the schedule for each pet at the visit. For puppies and kittens it's usually a series every three to four weeks until about sixteen weeks, then yearly or every three years depending on the vaccine. I can book the next visit.
entries.notes: General only. Never say which vaccines a specific pet needs.

entries.default_setting_value: We're by appointment, but if {{pet_name}} is unwell I can usually find a same-day slot or set up a drop-off.

conditional.telehealth_enabled: Yes, for pets the doctor has seen in the last year. Want me to book one?
conditional.telehealth_disabled: We see pets in person. I can book the next available visit.

entries.answer: The team talks through all of those options personally. I'll have someone call you back today, and I can book the appointment if you'd like.

entries.default_setting_value: We don't offer boarding or grooming, but I can suggest a nail trim or a sedated groom with the doctor if that helps.

question_variants: how do I register the microchip
entries.answer: The team can help you update the registration. Bring the microchip number and we'll sort it at the visit, or I can leave a note for them to call you.

question_variants: can I talk to a person
entries.answer: Of course. Let me connect you to the team.

question_variants: can I see the same doctor
entries.notes: Read from provider schedules. Offer slots with the requested doctor first.

entries.answer: I am not able to give medical advice, but I can get {{pet_name}} seen. The next available is {{slot_1}} or {{slot_2}}.
entries.notes: Triage still runs. If an emergency trigger matches, W6 overrides this.
